title: Dryer Takes Two Cycles to Dry
meta_description: Clothes taking 2 to 3 cycles to dry? Learn why clogged dryer vents cause long drying times and how professional lint cleaning restores fast drying.
symptom: Extended drying times exceeding 50 minutes per load
primary_cause: Restricted exhaust airflow causing high backpressure and thermal tripping
recommended_action: Professional rotary brush cleaning and airflow CFM test

title: Dryer Hot to Touch & Burning Smell
meta_description: Dryer burning smell or excessively hot top? Emergency warning signs of dangerous lint buildup. Call for immediate same-day safety dispatch.
symptom: Scorching dryer cabinet exterior and acrid burnt lint odor
primary_cause: Trapped lint in proximity to the heating element or gas burner chamber
recommended_action: Turn off dryer immediately and schedule emergency vent clearout

title: Dryer Error Code D80, D90 or Flow Sense Warning
meta_description: LG or Samsung dryer showing D80, D90, or Flow Sense bar? 80% to 90% duct blockage detected. We clear clogs and reset your dryer today.
symptom: Digital display error code D80, D90, or Flow Sense indicator blinking
primary_cause: Smart pressure differential sensor detecting severe duct obstruction
recommended_action: Complete duct line rotary scrub and exterior cap inspection

title: Water Dripping From Dryer Vent or Wall Condensation
meta_description: Water dripping from dryer duct or wet laundry room walls? Discover how clogged vents cause condensation puddles and how to fix it.
symptom: Puddling water beneath the transition duct or sweaty laundry walls
primary_cause: Moisture-laden air stalling in the vent, condensing into water and lint sludge
recommended_action: Duct cleanout and insulation verification in unconditioned attics

title: Exterior Dryer Vent Flaps Not Opening Outside
meta_description: Outside dryer vent flap stuck closed or blowing lint onto the ground? Clear lint jams and animal guards with certified technician service.
symptom: Outdoor damper louvers stay flat when dryer is actively running
primary_cause: Lint cake jammed in louver hinge or animal nesting behind the hood
recommended_action: Exterior hood cleaning and heavy-gauge pest guard installation
